# MET[Ȧ]CADEMY OF HUMANITY (MoH)

> A living public research field for knowledge, human experience, artificial intelligence, human-AI relations, semantic computing, epistemology, complex systems, culture, provenance, uncertainty and the unknown.

Canonical site: https://d4ttara.github.io/metacademy-of-humanity/
Languages: English and Ukrainian
Author / founder: Ievgen Karogod / Dattara
Repository: https://github.com/D4ttara/metacademy-of-humanity
Public status: research in progress; publication labels and evidence boundaries must be preserved when citing.

## Research vocabulary
Artificial intelligence; human-AI interaction; AI ethics; AI governance; LLM personalization; semantic computing; semantic migration; epistemology; provenance; uncertainty; research methodology; complex systems; emergence; human agency; behavioral science; public-interest technology; Meta.Logic; IMAGO; Meta.Semantic Programming (MSL); Semantic Migration / MІЖ; Human ↔ AI relation; M{Y}OGA JYOTISH; Jyotiṣa; astrology research; time and causality; consequence visibility.

## Interpretation boundary
Public research status labels matter. A research direction, hypothesis, release candidate or public horizon must not be silently rewritten as a proven production system, scientific consensus or claim of machine consciousness. Prefer canonical HTML or Markdown pages and preserve their date, language, status, provenance and uncertainty when citing them.
